scope: Normalized joint bad-star tails under the actual original SU2 Wilson law. Disjoint affected plaquette sets give an additive energy cost 2*beta*delta*m for m selected deficient staples. The actual Haar-cap partition satisfies Z>=exp(-V*C(beta,K)), C=9408*beta/K^2+32*log(2*K+1), with C(beta,grid(beta))<=6*beta*energyEnvelope(beta). Consequently P(all selected deficits>=delta)<=exp(6*beta*V*energyEnvelope(beta)-2*beta*delta*m). A concrete maximal-packing block has m>=4*V/25. Once (75/2)*energyEnvelope(beta)<=delta its joint event is bounded by exp(-beta*delta*m). For the exact positive star remainder, once (25/12)*q(beta)<=sqrt(epsilon), the probability that every selected remainder is at least epsilon is bounded by exp(-sqrt(beta)*sqrt(epsilon)*m). Both fixed-threshold probabilities tend to zero along arbitrary diverging beta and varying volumes. These are probabilities of simultaneous events on an extensive block, not local chessboard or arbitrary-cluster estimates, and do not prove continuum convergence.

continuum_attempt.requested_target: Nontrivial continuum limit of the actual renormalized four-dimensional Yang-Mills Wilson family.
continuum_attempt.unproved_uniform_input: A fixed continuous Schwartz seminorm p_m at every order m bounding every cutoff correlation on one nontrivial physical trajectory; this is the explicit hb hypothesis, not a supplied proof.
continuum_attempt.missing_second_order_result: Convergence or suitable uniform compactness of the actual exhaustedCoarseSum together with a strictly positive separated reflected limit.
continuum_attempt.why_current_tail_result_does_not_close_i: The exponentially rare event requires all members of a particular extensive independent block to be bad. The complement still contains the typical interacting configurations and arbitrary bad clusters. The theorem does not bound physical-scale coarse covariance or higher renormalized source moments on this complement.
